health.name: health
health.usageInstructions:
### Health
Injury capacity. Base 100 plus species: Starian +125, Human +20, Kharai +20, Rivani +10, Olyth +30, Zencadian +0, Elyri +40; Chorus keeps its host's.
### Deduct only for a resolved injury
- Minor wound: 5-15% of maximum
- Serious wound: 15-35% of maximum (a clean plasma, energy or heavy-caliber hit to an unarmored body)
- Near-fatal: down to 1-10% of maximum
### Do not deduct when
- An existing wound or pain is described again
- The character is unconscious, carried or stabilized
- Growth raises the maximum (no refill)
### Recovery
No per-turn regeneration; a full rest restores a quarter of the maximum, and treatment, doctors and suitable healing magic add to that through actual care. Nothing reverses confirmed death. Growth per level: Starian 9, Human/Kharai 5, Rivani/Zencadian 4, Olyth 6, Elyri 7, plus the engine's five-level milestone.
### Thresholds
Defeat allows withdrawal, surrender, rescue or capture; arena defeat is nonlethal; never narrate death then call it hospitalization.

stamina.name: stamina
stamina.usageInstructions:
### Stamina
Resolved bodily exertion. Maximum is the bar's base plus 5 per Endurance point above 10; no level growth. Walking, commuting flight, talk and ordinary work cost 0.
### Cost (charge once)
- Brief meaningful exertion: 3
- Demanding maneuver or technique: 6
- Heavy exertion or difficult rescue: 12
- Extreme burst near current limits: 20
A leap, strike and landing is one charge; sustained work follows real duration, not sentence count.
### Do not deduct when
- A power is mentioned, observed or intended, not performed
- The effort is already on another bar; affinity has no fuel pool
- Rest is redeclared without elapsed time
### Recovery
Stamina returns 5 per turn of ordinary activity and fully on rest; do not narrate exhaustion that the bar no longer shows. A safe breather restores about a quarter.
### Thresholds
Low Stamina limits feasible effort; recovery heals no injury.

Vitality.name: Vitality
Vitality.usageInstructions:
### Vitality
Reserve of a trained traditional-magic practitioner, not permission to cast. Maximum is the bar's base plus 5 per Resolve point above 10; no level growth. Unspent without a learned discipline; any biological species can learn.
### Cost (charge once)
- Light: 5
- Demanding: 10
- Heavy: 20
- Exceptional: as accepted
Inscription pays at making; invocation does not repay that debt.
### Do not deduct when
- Magic is mentioned, observed or discussed
- Starian affinity or Elyri embodiment is used (never Vitality)
### Recovery
Vitality returns 1 per turn and half of the maximum on a full rest; heavy debt still takes days of rest and no working repays it early. Overdraft injury needs care.
### Thresholds
Near 25 % warn of further heavy use. At 0 safe use stops. Overdraft brings supported strain, injury or death; no free casting, universal backlash or invented penalty.

Core Stability.name: Core Stability
Core Stability.usageInstructions:
### Core Stability
An Elyri's embodied stability. 100 maximum, no level growth; control makes work safer, not the pool bigger. Only Elyri embodiment spends it; learned magic uses Vitality.
### Cost (charge once)
- Light: 5
- Demanding: 10
- Heavy: 20
- Exceptional: as supported
Equal cost is not equal output.
### Do not deduct when
- Stable existence or ordinary dialogue
- Already charged to another bar
### Recovery
On Nexara an Elyri's stability returns 2 per turn of ordinary existence and fully on rest; off Nexara it depends on the actual support in use. Any affinity Starian can recharge an Elyri, tiring until rest; Elyri can share packs.
### Thresholds
Near 25 % warn; at 0 safe use stops. Overdraft: dimmed eyes, flickering channels, weakness, lost fine control, transparency, leakage or fracture; no universal backlash. Distinct from Reservoir Charge; no numeric dormancy threshold.

Reservoir Charge.name: Reservoir Charge
Reservoir Charge.usageInstructions:
### Reservoir Charge
Percentage of the equipped external support device's capacity; 100 is that device full, not a universal quantity. Without a real reservoir the bar is irrelevant.
### Drain when
- Actual support use and elapsed time under that device's specification; devices differ at the same percentage
### Do not deduct when
- A turn passes (no per-turn tax or one-day capacity)
- Portrait or trait text changes (no refill either)
- A trip is merely booked; custody decides pack use
### Recovery
Only a recharge, sharing or replacement restores it, recorded once. Nexara and Aethrys sustain Elyri; Terra, Xeon and Chorus planets need external support.
### Thresholds
Zero is not automatically dormancy or death. At true critical depletion an Elyri goes immobile and emits a distress signal; unrecharged, it dies one year after dormancy (never converted to turns). Recharge repairs no core.
